notes: Call me out roasts the move, never the person: each option names what you did in its first two or three words, then adds one self-aware, true detail (the 2am stay, the rice week, the notes app full of plans, the salad you are still annoyed about). The jab is spread evenly so every pole gets the same wink, including the tidy answer, and no option reads as the healthy one. Levels, order and meanings follow bank.js exactly (celebration_budget keeps its -2, -1, +2, +1 order; fairness_rule and risk_style keep their no-level options). Emotion-coded options keep their private feeling (guilt on support_capacity B1, worry and sting on contact_needs, resentment on the salad split, longing on the cheaper favorite). All 15 scenes open with "Last time" to keep did-grade evidence; immersive setups appear only in quick takes and sealed checks. Trait words that slipped into the bank (one in second_chances option A) are replaced with a concrete move (small hangouts first). marriage_meaning, kids_someday, wedding_budget and commitment_pace stay 18+ only; the other love items are framed for any closest person so teens can answer.
